description: The current official Mass Mobilization dataset version, full observation universe, authoritative codebook/schema and contribution rules remain unverified. Provisional ccode 160 and local candidate IDs are not official mappings.
required_followup: Obtain the authoritative current files and verify version, hashes, universe, schema, codebook, license and mapping before any integration or official ID.

description: Twenty Spanish/English web queries cover weekly windows and selected regions/sectors, but open-web results do not replicate LexisNexis or constitute exhaustive coverage. Search-engine date filtering surfaced out-of-month and retrospective pages.
required_followup: Use accessible systematic newspaper/archive coverage and record unavailable holdings; do not treat unreturned results as absence.

description: Threshold attendance is unverified for E001–E009. Four opened candidate bodies use qualitative mass language or 'many people' without a site-level count; household need, vehicle flows, slogans and workforces are not attendance.
required_followup: Seek explicit site-level counts or a clear hundreds/thousands descriptor for each physical gathering; do not transfer campaign-wide estimates to local sites.

description: National/local grouping remains provisional for the February 18 social mobilization, the 27F campaign, the Chubut anti-megamining day and Formosa's five roadblock foci. Several search-only leads could be separate events or merely related reporting.
required_followup: Compare organizers, site-specific schedules, demands and physical episodes across contemporary local reporting before merging or splitting.

description: Seven state-response dimensions remain unknown for most candidates. E004 has an attributed report of accelerated housing-module deliveries after protests; that is partial accommodation, not a resolution. The Olivos attackers in S046 were described as unionists, not state agents.
required_followup: Find event-specific evidence on actual reception, arrests, beating, dispersal, explicit refusal, killings and firearm shootings; do not code silence or nonstate violence as state action.

description: Diario Crónica's exact 5 February anti-megamining article returned HTTP403 after a web Cache miss and a default-sandbox DNS failure. The article body was not read. The denial is respected; other publishers or an actor's own report are separate sources, not a mirror workaround.
required_followup: Use accessible independent contemporary reporting from other publishers; do not retry, bypass, mirror, or seek copies from Diario Crónica.

description: Search-only regional and sector leads remain unverified, including Mendoza health actions and strikes, Jujuy social/labor actions, Formosa/Clorinda, Córdoba piquetero and transport actions, CTA actions on 15/22 February, and Tucumán/Salta labor disputes. A strike, transport disruption or scheduled action alone does not establish a qualifying public gathering.
required_followup: Open permitted original bodies after a fresh full-universe access guard and verify physical date, crowd, own-state target, responses and episode boundaries.

description: TN confirms the TUDA road campaign continued into February 4 but describes its start only as mid-January; exact start and the end of all sites remain unresolved. January's February 18 food/work boundary lead now points to a distinct February 18 action, not demonstrated continuous assembly. Fishers and Añelo received only boundary searches, with no verified February continuation.
required_followup: Reconcile with January unit owners' decisions and follow each episode through later reporting; do not infer a close from article date, improving truck throughput or month-end.

description: Infobae S038 is an AMP URL variant of S001; S087 is a separate search-only lead with unverified written origin. The 27F reports (S005–S009, S012, S047) are search-only; shared event/title/date does not prove independent reporting. MULCS S025 is an organizer report.
required_followup: Compare bylines and written-story origin when opening related outlets; distinguish agency attribution, actor statements, photo credits and duplicated articles.

description: Research was conducted in Spanish and English. Indigenous/local-language coverage and systematic regional archives were not searched. Search snippets and date-coded URLs remain discovery metadata, not body evidence.
required_followup: Add relevant local-language archives or community sources when accessible and record translation/source limitations.
